title:
Liliata rutilantium. Turma circumdet.
 Iubilantium te virginum. Chorus excipiat.
html_source:
Words from the prayer he did not say at his mothers deathbed.
Full prayer:
“Liliata rutilantium te confessorum turma circumdet: iubilantium te virginum chorus excipiat”
“May the troop of confessors, glowing like lilies, surround you. May the choir of virgins, jubilant, take you in”
